name: Gelateria Italiana
kurzbeschreibung:
**Welcome to Gelateria Italiana in Tirol!**

Indulge in the finest **Gelateria Italiana** flavors right in the heart of **Tirol**. Our authentic Italian gelato is crafted with love, using only the freshest ingredients to bring you a taste of Italy—no matter where you are.

From creamy **Stracciatella** to rich **Pistachio**, our menu offers a delightful variety of classic and seasonal flavors. Pair your gelato with a **Kaiserschmarrn** or a warm **Apfelstrudel** for the perfect sweet treat.

Visit us in **Innsbruck**, **Hall in Tirol**, or **Kitzbühel**—where every scoop is a journey to Italy!

**Gelateria Italiana – Dolce Vita in Tirol!**
